artworks.title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with an elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third, with a body of water stretching across it. There are buildings on the shore. Tall trees frame the scene, with detailed brushwork showing leaves and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly sepia tones. In the distance, there are hills and clouds with nuanced shading, creating depth in the landscape.

artworks.title: The Samaritan Pours Oil and Wine in the Wounds of a Man Left for Dead
artworks.description: This is an image of a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is in the top third of the image, revealing a castle-like structure surrounded by hills and vegetation. Smoke is seen coming from the castle towers against a backdrop of clouds. The etching technique creates texture and depth in the trees and rocky terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia tones. In the foreground, two figures are visible, one reclining under a tree and the other attending to them.

artworks.title: The Samaritan Takes the Man to an Inn
artworks.description: This monochromatic print depicts a rugged landscape with elements of architecture and nature. Two figures stand on a ledge, while another carries a burden. Sturdy trees and a stone bridge are visible along with distant ruins. Rocky outcroppings lead to a flowing body of water dominating the right side. Stone architecture lines the horizon against the sky. The scene features meticulous engravings creating textures from rocks to water ripples. The limited gray and sepia tones evoke a classical and harmonious quality in this pastoral setting.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape with two figures and a donkey walking on a narrow wooden bridge. Nearby are two classical columns, one with a circular object on top. A winged figure is seen in motion nearby. In the background, there is rocky terrain, water reflecting light, buildings, structures, and mountains on the horizon. The sky is filled with clouds. The artwork is a monochromatic engraving with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Pharisees Complain to Our Lord
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white engraving of a landscape with a group of people and animals on a path leading towards a grand, arched ruin. The perspective is slightly elevated, allowing a view of the horizon, framed by an archway and distant hills and water. The detailed lines and cross-hatching create textures and depth. The color palette is grayscale, giving a timeless feel. Trees, stone structures, and people are intricately depicted, with foliage framing the scene.

artworks.title: Jesus and the Samaritan
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with mountains, a castle emitting smoke, and trees in the foreground. The engraving style displays intricate line work in shades of gray and black. In the front, two figures interact near a basin, while a sheep grazes to the left. In the distance, the castle stands among dense foliage and rocky terrain with clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Figures on a Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a cascading river, a rustic bridge, a wooden water mill, two figures and a horse near the structure, a detailed castle on the horizon, rocky outcrops, foliage, mountains, detailed linework and delicate hatchings emphasizing texture and depth. The color palette is black and white, highlighting contrast. Tall trees, cattle grazing, and a serene pastoral setting are also depicted.

artworks.title: Landscape with Wagon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated view. In the background, there is a large structure, possibly a castle or fortress. The sky is filled with clouds with fine lines. The scene includes a horse-drawn cart moving along a rocky path, and there is vegetation like trees and shrubs. The image has a monochromatic palette with detailed texture and depth achieved through line work and shading.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Frightened Waggoner
artworks.description: The image showcases a landscape with natural and architectural elements. In the foreground, there is a rocky, watery terrain with a cart pulled by oxen and a handler. A tree with lush foliage leans over the water. In the background, an ancient arched structure is visible. The horizon is obscured by trees and structures, under a dramatic sky with swirling clouds and lightning. The detailed lines create depth and texture, resembling an engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray to emphasize contrast and texture.

artworks.title: Mercury and Venus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.3 x 13.4 cm (7 3/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a wooded scene with mythical creatures. The image features two figures in a detailed forest setting. One figure is seated holding a musical instrument or stick, while the other standing figure points a large arrow. Above them, a small winged creature hovers. The trees are intricately decorated with lush foliage, and a distant cityscape is visible against a layered sky.

artworks.title: The Siege of Breda [plate 1 of 6]
artworks.description: This image shows a bird's-eye view of a detailed landscape. The horizon is high in the image, overlooking a vast terrain. The landscape includes rows of tents and troops in the distance, as well as intricate fields and pathways closer to the viewer. The terrain has gentle rises and falls, with small structures and annotations. The image has fine details with an engraved look, using pen and ink. It has a monochrome color palette, relying on ink contrasts for depth. There are distinctive architectural details and a coat of arms at the top, suggesting a historical context.

artworks.title: The Siege of Breda [plate 2 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view illustration of the Siege of Breda. The landscape and fortifications are depicted in detail, with the horizon placed high in the composition. The style is intricate and technical, with precise ink lines forming defenses, fields, and figures. The color palette is mainly black, gray, and pale beige. A detailed fortified city is shown close to the viewer, surrounded by encampments and military formations. Various paths and structures can be seen in the distance, indicating a wide field of action during the siege.

artworks.title: The Siege of Breda [plate 3 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial map-like view of a landscape. The horizon is in the upper part, leading to distant rolling hills. The brushstrokes and line work are finely detailed, hinting at a drafting or etching technique. The image is mainly monochromatic, with varying shades of gray and sepia creating a muted effect. Closest to the viewer is a detailed depiction of a town or military camp with tiny structures and organized patterns indicating roads and boundaries. Further out, there are fields, rivers, soft hills, and occasional patches of trees fading into the horizon.

artworks.title: The Siege of Breda [plate 4 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a monochromatic bird's-eye view of a landscape. The scene includes soldiers, buildings, walls, fields, a shoreline with boats, trees, and hills. The detailed linework conveys a strategic battle or siege scenario with precision and texture.

artworks.title: The Siege of Breda [plate 5 of 6]
artworks.description: The image is an aerial view of a landscape featuring a historical scene with military elements. Small figures are depicted engaged in various activities around a village-like setting with buildings and tents. A road with carts and groups of people can be seen. Rows of tents and formations of figures suggest an army encampment. In the background, a fortified structure with angular walls is visible, with a sparse, flat horizon showcasing a few buildings and a river. The illustration is in a monochromatic palette with intricate linework characteristic of etching techniques, creating a detailed composition.

artworks.title: The Siege of Breda [plate 6 of 6]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large-scale military encampment and battlefield. The scene features numerous groups of soldiers arranged in formations, along with horses and carriages. Figures on horseback and on foot are in the foreground, while a densely wooded area is seen in the distance, with faint outlines of hills. The organization of forces suggests a historical battlefield, showcasing troop positioning and movement during an engagement. The meticulous attention to detail in depicting soldiers, equipment, and the landscape conveys a sense of the strategic and chaotic elements of military maneuvers of the period.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Angels
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in various poses. In the center, a woman is sitting with an infant on her lap. Three angels surrounded them - two standing on either side of the woman and one sitting to the left. Another infant is standing close to the woman and child. The background has a lined texture with drapery hanging above.

artworks.title: The Siege of La Rochelle [plate 1 of 16;  set comprises 1952.8.97-112]
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.6 × 60.3 cm (6 9/16 × 23 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative architectural element with historical and heraldic imagery. The image features a richly detailed symmetrical design with a large crest on the left, adorned with a crown and two heraldic shields. Below the crest, there is a circular decoration with symbolic elements. In the middle, there are musical horns and other intricate baroque-style decorations surrounding a scene depicting figures in a public or ceremonial space. The word "OBSID" is inscribed at the top of the drawing and the text "Les Rochelleys demandant pardon au Roi" is at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Siege of La Rochelle [plate 2 of 16;  set comprises 1952.8.97-112]
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.6 × 46.3 cm (6 9/16 × 18 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an engraving portraying a man within an oval medallion in an ornate frame. The man has a pointed mustache, a styled beard, wavy hair, and is dressed in traditional clothing reminiscent of the 17th century with a high lace collar. The frame is decorated with flags, banners, regal symbols, shields, and other ornamental details. The background features classical architecture with columns and geometric lines. Large 'I' and 'R' letters frame the top of the image. The design suggests a celebration of royalty or nobility.

artworks.title: The Siege of La Rochelle [plate 3 of 16;  set comprises 1952.8.97-112]
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.7 × 59.6 cm (6 9/16 × 23 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring intricate ornate designs surrounding a scene depicting a procession. A central medallion contains a bustling scene with mounted figures and an assembled multitude, potentially soldiers. The medallion is flanked by elaborate scrollwork with mythological beast motifs. Above the medallion, large capital letters spell out 'VPELLÆ'. On the right side, a decorated crown adorns a coat of arms featuring fleur-de-lis and a geometric grid-like symbol, encircled by a wreath. The architectural elements frame the significance of the event captured in the scene.

artworks.title: The Siege of La Rochelle [plate 4 of 16;  set comprises 1952.8.97-112]

artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 57.6 × 16.5 cm (22 11/16 × 6 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a printed text document. The document contains a decorative heading and an elaborate textual description below. The top part features an ornately designed angelic figure surrounded by draped fabric flowing into ribbon-like scrolls on each side. The text is a mix of uppercase and lowercase printing, showing an elegant and formal style typically seen in historical documents. The upper section has large, bold letters that could be a title or heading. The lower section includes a block of text in French, arranged neatly. The document may describe or commemorate an event, pay homage to a person, or be relevant to the era it was created in. The borders resemble a picture frame, enhancing its formal presentation.

artworks.title: The Siege of La Rochelle [plate 5 of 16;  set comprises 1952.8.97-112]

artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a coastal region drawn with fine, detailed ink work. The horizon is elevated and slightly curved, displaying the coastline. There are small sailing vessels near the shore. In the middle-to-distant sections, there are numerous buildings with tiny figures, possibly resembling a historical or military scene. The lines of the artwork create different shades and textures, depicting waves and the coastline. The color palette is monochrome with various grays and blacks against an off-white background. Smoke can be seen at points along the coast and within the buildings.

artworks.title: The Siege of La Rochelle [plate 6 of 16;  set comprises 1952.8.97-112]
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 57 × 45 cm (22 7/16 × 17 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a detailed map or landscape scene depicting a historical or strategic location with fortifications and an extended terrain. The horizon is at the top of the image, displaying a gradual rising of the land filled with various small structures and settlements. The brushstrokes or lines are finely detailed, suggesting a meticulous rendering technique typical of cartographic or illustrative art. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly shades of brown and cream. A fortified city or town is depicted in the lower part of the image, with buildings and walls. Various roads and paths extend beyond the city, leading to dispersed settlements and encampments. In the distance, rolling fields and scattered lines of trees and structures add depth to the landscape, with small figures positioned across the terrain.

The landscape resembles a historical battlefield or countryside settlement with intricate details including soldiers, horses, civilians, roads, buildings, and trees. The view extends infinitely with no clear horizon separating land and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray and black, giving it a historical or cartographic look. The image appears to be an etching or lithograph, with delicate and meticulous brushstrokes or lines.
